<h1 class="fs-2">Our Pricing</h1>

{% image "img/gopher_flower_wide.jpg", "A gopher sniffing a flower.", "img-fluid mb-3" %}

<p>We are a firm believer in having a straightforward price list and as few extraneous fees as possible. All prices include service on as many as four people at the same address for the same case as long as we are able to serve everyone at the same time.</p>
<p>We believe in charging for effort, not paperwork. Our rates include complimentary printing up to 50 pages. We do have additional charges for serving large documents, skiptracing for a good address, providing witness fees for subpoenas, and serving on a Rush or Same Day basis.</p>

<h2 class="fs-2 mt-5">Our Services</h2>
<p class="lead">At Palmetto Legal Gophers, we have a proven record of serving papers for our customers safely and efficiently. We want our customers to be thrilled with our work, not just satisfied.</p>

<div class="service my-3 p-3">

	{{ item.content }}
	{% image item.img, item.alt, "img-fluid mb-3" %}
</div>
